stories.title: Duane Davis Convicted of Murdering Tupac Shakur After Decades of Speculation
stories.summary: Duane Keith Davis, known as 'Keffe D', was found guilty of first-degree murder for orchestrating the 1996 drive-by shooting of rapper Tupac Shakur. The verdict was delivered by a jury in Nevada on August 31, 2026, marking a significant moment in a case that has remained unresolved for nearly 30 years. Davis, who is 63 years old, is currently being held without bail and faces a maximum sentence of life in prison without parole at his upcoming sentencing on October 13.

stories.title: Russian Air Strikes Kill 12 in Kyiv Region Amid Ongoing Attacks
stories.summary: Russian air attacks on Kyiv and its surrounding region have resulted in at least 12 fatalities and numerous injuries, marking the sixth consecutive day of strikes. The assaults included drone and missile attacks, with significant damage reported, particularly at a railway depot in the city. Authorities noted that the attacks are part of an escalation in air strikes as the conflict continues.

stories.title: Lionel Messi Retires from International Football After 21 Years
stories.summary: Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football at the age of 39, concluding a remarkable 21-year career with Argentina. He leaves as the nation's record appearance holder and top scorer, having recently led the team to the 2026 World Cup final. Messi expressed that the decision was difficult but felt it was the right time to step away from the national team.

stories.title: Algeria Considers Death Penalty for Arson Following Deadly Wildfires
stories.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has proposed reinstating the death penalty for individuals found guilty of deliberately setting forest fires. This decision follows a series of wildfires that resulted in the deaths of 12 people and injuries to dozens more. Currently, 46 fires are still active across several eastern provinces, with many victims hospitalized, some in critical condition.

The assailant, who had a history of mental health issues, was shot and killed by police at the scene after they attempted to use less lethal measures.
